tools.name: foodbe_query
tools.description: Ask a single food question and get a grounded, cited answer from Foodbe's fact-checked corpus. Refuses rather than guessing if no verified answer exists.

tools.name: foodbe_query_all
tools.description: Ask a food question and get answers from all three Foodbe expert voices at once: Neuro (science), Oracle (history/culture), Chefy (technique).

tools.name: foodbe_ingredient
tools.description: Get a structured profile of a specific ingredient: nutrition, allergens, diets, price, environmental impact.
